m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You want to know about Fire? Well, for starters, it's the most powerful school. Its magic is derived from the Dragons that ruled in the time of Titans.
Before the Dragons could destroy the Giants by melting them into the sea, the Great Tree and Great Raven put them into a magical slumber.
If you ever decide to join a real school, not saying that Balance is all that bad, consider Fire. But only if you want to join the best.
Are you kidding? Storm is the most powerful of the schools. Back in the First Age, the Tritons practically drowned all the Dragons by themselves!
If Bartleby had not stopped them, well, there wouldn't be any Fire School. But you won't hear Falmea speak of that!
Life, Death and Myth, they have their good points. But, to watch Professor Balestrom cast a Stormzilla, well, you know Storm is to be feared...
You ask what is so exciting about the Ice School? Well, when I was a young girl, I loved the wintertime and played in the snow. So going to the Ice School was only natural.
But in later years, I grew to learn how powerful Ice was. Did you know the Great Raven caused the Giants to slumber and turn into the glaciers?
With the force of Giants behind our school, I don't have to boast about how powerful our Magic is. I have never regretted the day I started here.
So you have spoken with the representatives of the Fire, Ice and Storm schools. You noticed how they all claim to be the best school, didn't you?
Well, they all speak the truth, in their own way. Each school has its advantages, but each school also has its own disadvantages.
But Balance draws on elements from each of the other schools, incorporating bits and pieces to fill in the gaps between them.
Visit the pond in the Commons. Stand in the water and absorb what it has to teach you. Believe it or not, you will receive enlightenment...
So, you were visited by a Minion of Balance? Smashing! It seems you have completed your first assignment, $PLAYER_FIRSTNAME$!
Talk to the representatives from Fire, Ice and Storm. When you've learned a thing or two from them, return here. Toodles!
I say! You appear to be ready for advancement. In order to know Balance you will need to know of the other schools first.
Learn about the schools of Fire, Ice and Storm from their representatives. Only by knowing the edges will you find the center of things. Toodles...!
